subject: Payment profile realignment & early-pay routing for Velotech onboarding
messages:
From: Leo Chan <leo.chan@velotech.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Accounts Payable <ap@velotech.com>, Lisa Nguyen <lisa@velotech.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding & payment terms question

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. We're starting the vendor setup for Velotech to begin using Redwood for the Velotech AI integration. A couple of items from our side to confirm so we can get PO + invoice routing right:

- Velotech prefers Net45 but is open to Net30 if we can enroll in an early-pay program for a 1.5% fee.
- Our AP team needs the exact invoice email address and whether Redwood requires PO numbers on the invoice line items or as a header.
- Attached is our supplier onboarding packet (Velotech_Onboarding_Form.pdf).

Can you confirm Redwood's preferred remittance email, whether ACH is supported, and whether you require W-9 for US vendors? If possible, we'd like to lock payment cadence before we issue the first PO.

Appreciate it — 
Leo
Leo Chan
Procurement Manager, Velotech Inc.
Attachments: Velotech_Onboarding_Form.pdf (pdf)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Leo Chan <leo.chan@velotech.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding & payment terms question

Leo —

Thanks for the packet and the clear asks. Quick answers and next steps: 

- Remittance: invoices should be sent to invoices@redwood.com. For faster processing, include the PO# in both the invoice header and each line item description.
- ACH: yes, we support ACH and wire. Finance will share account/rail details once the vendor record is active.
- W-9: yes, for US entities we need a completed W-9. Please attach when you send first invoice or upload to the onboarding link.

Regarding terms: Net45 is fine to capture on the PO. If Velotech wants early-pay, we have an early-pay pilot through our finance team that supports up to Net0 for a fee. Typical structure is a 1–2% fee depending on the settlement window. David (cc'd) — can you confirm the pilot rate bands and whether Velotech qualifies?

Next steps:
1) Velotech to return W-9 and confirm banking preference (ACH vs wire).
2) We will provision the vendor record and share the vendor ID + account details for remittance.
3) If you want early-pay, confirm target settlement days and we will send the enrollment terms (DocuSign).

I'll keep this thread as the canonical place for the onboarding docs.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | jonas_weber@redwood.com
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Leo Chan <leo.chan@velotech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding & payment terms question

Jonas / Leo —

Thanks for the ping. Quick finance note on early-pay:

- Velotech appears eligible for our standard early-pay program (onboarding vendors are allowed after KYC + W-9).
- Fee guidance: 1.5% for settlement within 10 days, 1.0% for settlement within 15 days, 0.6% for settlement within 30 days. We can issue sample settlement terms via DocuSign.
- Required docs: W-9 (US), vendor bank details (ACH), and signed early-pay enrollment (DocuSign).

I've attached a blank W-9 (Velotech_W9.pdf) and our Redwood_AP_Instructions.pdf with invoice formatting examples. Once Jonas confirms the PO requirements we'll finalize the vendor setup and return the Redwood Vendor ID.

David Kim
Finance Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Velotech_W9.pdf (pdf); Redwood_AP_Instructions.pdf (pdf)
From: Accounts Payable <ap@velotech.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Leo Chan <leo.chan@velotech.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 May 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding & payment terms question

Jonas / David —

Thanks for the clarity. We received the AP instructions and W-9. A couple housekeeping items before we issue the PO:

- Velotech will accept Net45 on the PO but requests consideration for 15-day settlement at the 1.0% fee band; please send the enrollment DocuSign link and vendor ID so we can route invoices to the correct vendor record.
- Invoice submission: invoices will be sent to invoices@redwood.com (per guidance). Please confirm that the PO must be present as PO: 10-digit number in the header and on each invoice line.
- Payment remittance: Velotech will use ACH; please provide Redwood's ACH details once vendor is active.

We'll upload the completed W-9 and a copy of our standard invoice template to the onboarding portal today. Once we have the DocuSign link and vendor ID we will issue the first PO.

Thanks,
Velotech Accounts Payable
Attachments: Velotech_Sample_Invoice.xlsx (xlsx)
